correctness.rationale: For meet semilattice C_n={0,…,n−1}, if (i,j),i<j is in reflexive meet-compatible R, meeting with (k,k) for i<k≤j forces (i,k), and likewise lower-directed entries. Thus all off-diagonal pairs uniquely comprise two independent row/column interval thresholds u_i,v_i. Conversely any two arbitrary thresholds yield meet closure: comparable pairs meet to one operand, crossed pairs force the meet by the upper interval of one pair or lower interval of the other. Coordinatewise threshold order gives lattice (∏_{k=1}^n C_k)^2, exactly (n!)² relations and rank generating polynomial ∏_{k=1}^n(1+…+z^{k−1})². Symmetry requires u=v (n! choices); congruences are consecutive-interval partitions (2^{n−1}). Therefore χ(C_n)=2^{n−1}/(n!)² including n=1, and Stirling gives the stated asymptotic. Independent exhaustive enumeration of every reflexive binary relation for n≤4 verified counts 1,4,36,576 and compatibility independently, not relied on for all n.
